title: Eiffel Tower (Paris, Tennessee)
geometryBasis: Named 19-vertex circular platform, exact Qualla December 2021 photograph and height published by the City of Paris.
sectionBasis: Four tapered open steel legs with curved arch bracing, an intermediate deck carried above the bell-shaped base, a narrow lattice spire and a small domed top platform.
limitations: December 2021 exterior geometry. Seasonal light ornaments, small signs and nearby playground fixtures are outside scope.
The 60-foot height follows the City of Paris park listing. Intermediate deck heights, axis rotation and lattice dimensions are estimates drawn from the cleared photograph and platform outline.
